definitions.explanation: A formal Sino-Japanese prefix marking that something has already occurred or is already in place. Common in administrative, legal, and academic writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{既|き}{婚|こん}{者|しゃ}→既婚者：11335_kikonsha⟧{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧です。
examples.english: This survey is for married people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{既|き}{存|そん}→既存：27736_kison⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}→活用：02620_katsuyou⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to make use of the existing system.

examples.japanese: {既|き}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦{対象外|たいしょうがい}→対象外：10019_taishougai⟧です。
examples.english: Already-published papers are excluded from review.

notes:
Bound prefix, never used standalone. Marks a state as already established or completed.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{既|き}{婚|こん}→既婚：16160_kikon⟧: married (already wed)
- ⟦{既|き}{存|そん}→既存：27736_kison⟧: existing; pre-existing
- {既|き}{成|せい}: ready-made; established
- ⟦{既|き}{知|ち}→既知：19828_kichi⟧: known; already-known
- ⟦{既|き}{往|おう}{歴|れき}→既往歴：26536_kioureki⟧: medical history (literally 'already-past history')

SIMILAR PREFIXES:
- ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧〜: not yet; un- — the direct antonym (⟦{未|み}{婚|こん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧ unmarried, ⟦{未|み}{知|ち}→未知：13014_michi⟧ unknown)
- ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧〜: former; old- — focuses on what something used to be, not on completion
